  - The example in the hero (n = 3, t = 3, p = 2, site/problem/example.dat), its front and the

    The front SVG is drawn by hand from the same points.
  - 66 of 66, slowest 61 ms (zeno); 66 of 66 with the same front (zeno-front); 66 of 66 accepted

<div class="zs-home">

<section class="home-hero" aria-labelledby="home-title">
  <h1 class="home-title" id="home-title">A multi-objective planning benchmark with exact, <span class="nobr">proven</span> Pareto fronts.</h1>
  <div class="home-copy">
    <p class="home-lede"><strong>MultiZenoTravel</strong>: planes carry passengers from C<sub>I</sub> to C<sub>G</sub> through central cities. Every landing has a price, and the cheap cities are the far ones, so each plan trades its <strong>cost</strong> against its <strong>makespan</strong>. The best trade-offs form the Pareto front.</p>
    <p class="home-lede"><strong>ZenoSolver</strong> computes that front exactly. For symmetric durations, the front theorem and a solver are proved in Lean 4, and every front of the benchmark suite carries a certificate accepted by a checker proved sound in Lean 4.</p>
  </div>

<script src="js/plan-viewer.js"></script>
<script>
(function () {
  var fig = document.getElementById('home-front');
  var demo = document.getElementById('home-demo');
  if (!fig || !demo) return;
  var svg = fig.querySelector('svg');
  var tip = fig.querySelector('.front-tip');
  var vc = tip.querySelector('.tip-c');
  var vm = tip.querySelector('.tip-m');
  var pts = Array.prototype.slice.call(fig.querySelectorAll('.pt'));
  var on = null;
  var viewer = null;

  // Hover and focus: a tooltip with the point's cost and makespan.
  function show(pt) {
    if (on) on.classList.remove('is-on');
    on = pt;
    pt.classList.add('is-on');
    vc.textContent = pt.getAttribute('data-cost');
    vm.textContent = pt.getAttribute('data-makespan');
    tip.hidden = false;
    var s = svg.getBoundingClientRect();
    var f = fig.getBoundingClientRect();
    var k = s.width / 440;
    var x = s.left - f.left + parseFloat(pt.getAttribute('data-x')) * k;
    var y = s.top - f.top + parseFloat(pt.getAttribute('data-y')) * k;
    var w = tip.offsetWidth;
    var h = tip.offsetHeight;
    var left = Math.min(Math.max(x - w / 2, 0), f.width - w);
    var top = y - h - 14;
    if (top < 0) top = y + 14;
    tip.style.transform = 'translate(' + left + 'px, ' + top + 'px)';
  }
  function hide() {
    if (on) on.classList.remove('is-on');
    on = null;
    tip.hidden = true;
  }

  // Selection: a point of the front is a plan; picking it plays that plan on the map.
  function pick(pt) {
    if (!viewer) return;
    var cost = Number(pt.getAttribute('data-cost'));
    var i = viewer.data.plans.findIndex(function (p) { return p.cost === cost; });
    if (i < 0) return;
    viewer.select(i);
    viewer.play();
  }
  demo.addEventListener('zs-plan-select', function (e) {
    var first = viewer === null;
    viewer = e.detail.viewer;
    pts.forEach(function (pt) {
      var sel = Number(pt.getAttribute('data-cost')) === e.detail.plan.cost;
      pt.classList.toggle('is-sel', sel);
      pt.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(sel));
    });
    if (first) autoplay(viewer);
  });

  // Play the featured plan once, when the player first comes into view. Nothing moves on its
  // own for a reader who asked for reduced motion; the controls still play it.
  function autoplay(v) {
    if (window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return;
    if (typeof IntersectionObserver === 'undefined') return;
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
      if (!entries.some(function (en) { return en.isIntersecting; })) return;
      io.disconnect();
      if (!v.playing && v.tau === 0) v.play();
    }, { threshold: 0.6 });
    io.observe(demo.querySelector('.home-map'));
  }

  pts.forEach(function (pt) {
    pt.addEventListener('pointerenter', function () { show(pt); });
    pt.addEventListener('pointerleave', hide);
    pt.addEventListener('focus', function () { show(pt); });
    pt.addEventListener('blur', hide);
    pt.addEventListener('click', function () { pick(pt); });
    pt.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); pick(pt); }
    });
  });
})();
</script>
